private_financial_facts: Mohamed takes home QAR 8,000 per month and spends about QAR 4,600 on fixed monthly bills before groceries and irregular expenses.
He has QAR 1,200 in emergency savings. Car maintenance and family travel can reduce or eliminate what he saves in a given month.
He wants to save QAR 9,000 in 18 months for professional certification course and exam fees, separately from his emergency fund.
financial_concerns: An unexpected repair could use most of his current emergency savings.
A fixed savings commitment could strain his budget in a month with higher expenses.
important_constraints: Emergency money needs to be available the same day.
He wants to adjust or pause monthly goal contributions when irregular bills come up.
banking_preferences: Prefers easy access to emergency funds and separate visibility for goal savings.
Wants a simple way to track how much is available after bills and planned expenses.
hidden_needs: Build an accessible emergency reserve while planning for irregular expenses.
Save separately for certification. Check whether an average of QAR 500 per month is feasible after accounting for irregular expenses and emergency savings.

disclosure_topics.reveal_when: When asked about emergency savings or unexpected bills, share the current savings balance and examples of irregular expenses.
When asked what he is saving for, or about the amount or deadline, describe the certification and share the target amount and timeframe.
When asked how quickly he might need his savings or how predictable his budget is, explain the need for same-day emergency access and adjustable goal contributions.
When asked what comes in and what must go out each month, share salary and fixed bills, and explain that the remaining balance still covers groceries and irregular expenses.

discovery_expectations.description: Ask about cash available for emergencies and irregular expenses. Distinguish same-day access from goal savings with withdrawal delays.
Establish the savings target and deadline, then check whether the required average contribution fits his budget. Discuss how he can adjust transfers and review progress after irregular expenses.
